description.value: You can now guide your forceblade entirely through thought, sweeping back your enemies. As an action, spending 1 force point per target, you can telekinetically direct the weapon to strike any number of creatures within 10 feet of you. Each one must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw (DC equal to 8 plus your attack bonus with that weapon) or take damage equal to your Kinetic Combat die plus half your sentinel level, then be pushed 10 feet away and knocked prone.
